paragraphs.en: Ben Gunn stopped me by the arm and sat down upon seeing the colors.
paragraphs.zh: 本·古恩抓住我的胳膊，看到旗帜后坐了下来。

paragraphs.en: "Your friends," he declared confidently.
paragraphs.zh: “你的朋友们，”他自信地宣布。

paragraphs.en: "They could be the mutineers," I replied cautiously.
paragraphs.zh: “他们可能是叛乱分子，”我谨慎地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Not likely," Ben Gunn insisted. "Silver wouldn't hoist the Jolly Roger here, where only gentlemen of fortune come. Your friends are ashore in Flint's old stockade."
paragraphs.zh: “不大可能，”本·古恩坚持说道，“银狐不会在这里升起杰克罗杰旗，这里只来往那些有身份的绅士。你的朋友们应该还在弗林特旧营房里。”

paragraphs.en: Ben continued, "Flint was a man with a headpiece. He feared nothing but Silver—Silver was too genteel."
paragraphs.zh: 本接着说：“弗林特是个戴着头盔的人，他唯一的忌惮就是银色——那个举止太过优雅的家伙。”

paragraphs.en: "Alright," I said, "let’s assume you’re right. I should hurry to join my friends."
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”我说，“假设你没错的话，我应该赶紧去和朋友们会合。”

paragraphs.en: "Not you," Ben Gunn interjected. "You're just a boy, even if you are good. I'll go instead.
paragraphs.zh: “不是你，”本·古恩插话说，“你只是一个孩子，即便你很好。我去吧。”

paragraphs.en: Only when I see the squire or doctor and get their word of honor will I go. You must remember: 'A precious sight, more confidence.' And then pinch him."
paragraphs.zh: 只有见到管家或医生，并得到他们的保证后，我才肯去。你得记住：“亲眼所见，更加放心。”然后还要给他一个巴掌。

paragraphs.en: He pinched me again with his usual cleverness.
paragraphs.zh: 他又一次用他那惯有的机敏掐了我一下。

paragraphs.en: "Find me here if Ben Gunn is needed," he said. "Just where you found me today. Bring a white object alone.
paragraphs.zh: “如果本·冈恩需要我，就在这里找我。”他说，“就在你今天发现我的地方。只带一个白色的东西过来。”

paragraphs.en: You'll say, 'Ben Gunn has reasons of his own.'"
paragraphs.zh: 你会说：“本·古恩自有他的理由。”

paragraphs.en: "I think I understand," I responded. "You have something to propose and want to see the squire or doctor. Can I go now?"
paragraphs.zh: “我想我明白了，”我说，“你有事要提议，想见管家或医生。我可以走了吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Remember?" Ben asked anxiously.
paragraphs.zh: “你还记得吗？”本焦虑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Of course," I assured him. "A precious sight, and reasons of his own."
paragraphs.zh: “当然，”我向他保证，“确实难得一见，而且他自有他的理由。”

paragraphs.en: "Then you can go," he said, releasing me. "If you see Silver, don't sell out Ben Gunn—wild horses couldn’t drag it from you. And if the pirates camp ashore, there will be widows in the morning."
paragraphs.zh: “那你就可以走了。”他说着松开了我。“如果你见到西尔弗，可别出卖本·古恩——就是再厉害的马也拉不动你开口。要是海盗们上岸扎营，明天早上就会有寡妇出现。”

paragraphs.en: A loud explosion interrupted us, followed by a cannonball tearing through the trees and landing near our location. We fled in different directions.
paragraphs.zh: 一声巨响突然打断了我们，紧接着是一颗炮弹划破树梢，在附近轰然落地。我们四散奔逃。

paragraphs.en: For an hour, frequent reports shook the island as balls crashed through the woods. Hiding from these terrifying missiles, I moved from place to place until the bombardment ended. Though still cautious, I began to regain my courage and made a long detour east before creeping down towards the shore trees.
paragraphs.zh: 一小时之内，频繁的报告声震动着整个岛屿，球弹在树林中穿行。为了躲避这些可怕的飞弹，我东躲西藏，直到炮击停止。尽管依然小心谨慎，我的勇气也开始恢复，于是绕了一个长长的弯道向东方前进，然后才慢慢靠近岸边的树木。

paragraphs.en: As the sun set, the sea breeze rustled in the woods, and the tide was far out, leaving great tracts of sand exposed. The air chilled through my jacket after the day's heat. The HISPANIOLA still lay anchored where she had been; however, the Jolly Roger, the black flag of piracy, now flew from her peak.
paragraphs.zh: 夕阳西下，海风在树林间轻拂，潮水退去，大片沙滩裸露出来。一天的炎热过后，空气透过夹克变得凉爽起来。HISPANIOLA号仍旧停泊在原处，但她的船桅上已飘扬着杰克·罗尔的黑旗——海盗的标志。

paragraphs.en: Another cannonball whistled through the air as the last shot echoed. I watched the aftermath—men were destroying the jolly-boat with axes near the stockade. A fire burned near the river mouth, and a gig shuttled between it and the ship, the gloomy men shouting like children at their oars.
paragraphs.zh: 另一枚炮弹呼啸着划过空中，回声刚刚消散。我看着那片狼藉——栅栏附近的水手正用斧头破坏着小划子。河口处燃起了一堆火，一只轻便艇在船和火堆之间来回穿梭，那些阴沉的水手们像孩子一样在船桨上喊叫。

paragraphs.en: The sound in their voices suggested they had been drinking rum. Finally, I decided to return towards the stockade. Standing on the low, sandy spit that encloses the anchorage to the east, I saw a high, white rock rising from among low bushes further down.
paragraphs.zh: 他们说话的声音里带着几分醉意。最终，我决定返回木栅栏处。站在东侧码头外那片低矮的沙地上，我看见远处灌木丛中矗立着一块高大的白色岩石。

paragraphs.en: It occurred to me that this might be the white rock Ben Gunn had mentioned, and someday a boat would be needed, guiding me to its location.
paragraphs.zh: 我突然想到这可能是本·古恩提到的那块白岩石，将来或许需要一艘船将我带到它的位置。

paragraphs.en: I moved through the woods until I reached the rear of the stockade. The log-house was made of pine trunks, with floors elevated a foot or more above the sand. A porch at the door housed an odd artificial basin—a large iron ship's kettle sunk into the ground.
paragraphs.zh: 我穿过树林，来到木栅栏的后方。那座小屋由松木建造，楼板高出沙地一尺多。门口有一个奇特的人工水池——一个大铁锅被埋在地下。

paragraphs.en: Inside, only the framework remained, but one corner held a stone slab for a hearth and an old rusty basket for firewood. The slopes of the knoll and inside of the stockade had been cleared to build the house, revealing stumps from the destroyed grove. Moss, ferns, and small bushes clung to the sand near the streamlet.
paragraphs.zh: 屋内只剩下框架，但一角摆放着一块石板作为灶台，还有一个生锈的篮子用来装木柴。小丘和栅栏内的土地已被清理出来建房，露出了被砍伐树林留下的树桩。苔藓、蕨类植物和一些小灌木紧贴在溪流附近的沙地上生长。

paragraphs.en: The cold evening breeze whistled through every crack in the building, sprinkling fine sand on the floor. Sand was everywhere—irritating our eyes, teeth, and suppers, even dancing in the spring at the bottom of the kettle like porridge boiling.
paragraphs.zh: 寒风在屋子里的每一个缝隙中呼啸而过，细沙四处飞扬，刺痛着眼睛、牙齿，甚至让晚餐变得不那么可口。这些沙粒在水壶底部的泉水中跳跃翻腾，仿佛煮沸的粥一样。

paragraphs.en: Gray, the new man, had a bandage over his face from an injury sustained during his escape from mutineers. Poor old Tom Redruth lay stiff and stark under the Union Jack along the wall.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷，这位新来者，在从叛变的船员那里逃脱时受了伤，脸上缠着绷带。可怜的老汤姆·雷德斯托则僵硬地躺在墙边的英国国旗下。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett kept everyone busy. He divided the crew into watches, assigning tasks like gathering firewood and digging a grave for Redruth. The doctor was made cook, while I stood guard at the door.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长忙得让大家团团转。他把船员分成班组，分配了诸如收集柴火和为雷德鲁斯挖墓等任务。医生被任命为厨师，而我则负责守在门口警戒。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett himself checked on us frequently, boosting morale wherever needed.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长自己也经常来查看我们的状况，在需要的时候大大提升了士气。

paragraphs.en: The doctor would occasionally come to the door for some fresh air and rest his eyes, which were nearly blinded by smoke. He once told me, "Smollett is a better man than I am, Jim. That means a lot."
paragraphs.zh: 医生偶尔会来到门口透透气，休息一下几乎被烟熏红的眼睛。他曾对我说：“斯莫莱特比我要强得多，吉姆。这可是说的真心话。”

paragraphs.en: Another time, he asked, "Is Ben Gunn sane?" I replied, "I'm not sure, sir. He might be insane after three years on a desert island."
paragraphs.zh: 他又问：“本·古恩精神正常吗？”我回答说：“这我不确定，先生。他在荒岛上待了三年，可能已经失常了。”

paragraphs.en: The doctor agreed, saying that such isolation could affect one's sanity.
paragraphs.zh: 医生赞同这一观点，认为这样的隔离可能会对一个人的理智造成影响。

paragraphs.en: The doctor also mentioned his snuff box, which contained Parmesan cheese for Ben Gunn, adding, "Being particular about food can lead to unexpected benefits."
paragraphs.zh: 医生还提到了他的鼻烟盒，里面装着帕尔马干酪给本·古恩，并补充说：“对食物讲究一点可能会有意想不到的好处。”

paragraphs.en: After supper, we buried old Tom in the sand. Despite gathering some firewood, Captain Smollett was unsatisfied and told us to work harder tomorrow. The three leaders then discussed our future plans in a corner.
paragraphs.zh: 吃过晚饭后，我们把老汤姆埋在沙子里。尽管收集了一些柴火，斯莫莱特船长还是不满意，吩咐我们明天要更加努力地工作。随后，三位领导人便在一角悄悄商讨起我们的未来计划。

paragraphs.en: They were desperate, with supplies so low they might have starved into surrender before aid arrived. The best hope was to weaken the buccaneers until they either lowered their flag or fled with the HISPANIOLA. Only fifteen remained; two were wounded, and one severely, possibly dead.
paragraphs.zh: 他们处境危急，物资匮乏到可能在援军到来前就已经饿得投降了。唯一的希望是削弱海盗的力量，直到对方降下旗帜或是弃船逃走，带着“鹦鹉螺”号离开。目前只剩下十五人；其中两人受伤，一人伤势严重，或许已经不行了。

paragraphs.en: Every attack had to be cautious, prioritizing survival. Two allies bolstered their resolve: rum and the climate. The doctor predicted half would fall ill in a week due to their marsh camp and lack of remedies.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次攻击都必须小心翼翼，首要任务是确保生存。两位盟友靠酒精和气候提振士气。医生预测，由于他们在沼泽地扎营且缺乏药物，一周内会有半数人患病。

paragraphs.en: "So," he mused, "they'll gladly leave for the schooner if they're not shot first."
paragraphs.zh: “这么说来，”他沉吟道，“他们宁可上小艇也不愿先被射杀。”

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett sighed, “First ship I ever lost.”
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长叹了口气，“这是我第一次失去的船只。”

paragraphs.en: Exhausted, I slept deeply after tossing. Woken by voices and shouting, I rushed to a loophole in the wall upon hearing someone say "Flag of truce!" and then, "Silver himself!"
paragraphs.zh: 疲惫不堪，我辗转反侧地睡得很沉。听到有人喊“停火旗！”接着又有人说“塞弗尔本人！”的声音时，我被惊醒并冲向墙上的一个缺口。
